rows.grounds: demonstrative pointing to the hidden true nature
absolutive expressing prior act of knowing
compound denoting a concealed essential reality

items.question: What state arises from knowing that hidden true nature?
premises: There exists a hidden true nature.
That hidden true nature can be known.
Knowing it produces a resulting state.
items.inference: Knowing that hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The referent of taṃ may draw on the immediately preceding context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
